travelIntro.title: Sri Lanka holidays, shaped around you
travelIntro.introduction: Sri Lanka brings ancient cities, wildlife reserves, tea-covered hills and Indian Ocean beaches into one varied journey. Our Sri Lanka tour packages offer a starting point for your holiday, with room to balance discovery and downtime. Choose the places that interest you and plan a pace that suits your travelling companions.

culture.title: Culture and local stories
culture.text: Explore the Cultural Triangle, Sigiriya and Kandy to discover the island’s heritage. Allow time for temples, local food and the stories behind each place, rather than filling every day with long drives.

wildlife.title: Wildlife and outdoor experiences
wildlife.text: A safari can bring a different rhythm to your cultural tour. Browse wildlife activities and discuss the right parks and seasons for your route. Animal sightings depend on nature and are never guaranteed.

coast.title: Time for the coast
coast.text: Beach holidays can stand alone or round off a journey through the island. Combine sightseeing with a few slower days by the sea, choosing your coast around the season and the kind of stay you enjoy.

hills.title: Hill country and Ceylon tea
hills.text: Walk among tea plantations, enjoy mountain views and make time for the hill country around Ella and Nuwara Eliya. Tell us how you like to travel and we can help bring these experiences together in a personal itinerary.

privateTours.title: Private Sri Lanka Tours with a Chauffeur-Guide
privateTours.intro: Welcome to Roxaval Travels, a Sri Lanka-based tour operator offering private, tailor-made holidays. Every trip is planned around you: your pace, your interests, and your budget. Travel in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle with your own English-speaking chauffeur-guide, and see the island without the stress of public transport or fixed group schedules.

why.title: Why Travel Privately in Sri Lanka
why.text: Sri Lanka is small, but its roads are winding and journeys take longer than the map suggests. A private chauffeur-guide takes care of the driving, the timing, and the local knowledge, so you can stop for a photo, a tea plantation visit, or a roadside fruit stall whenever you like. No crowded buses, no rigid itineraries, and no wasted time.

destinations.title: Popular Destinations
items: Sigiriya and the Cultural Triangle: climb the ancient Lion Rock fortress and explore Polonnaruwa and Anuradhapura.
Kandy: visit the Temple of the Tooth and enjoy the hill capital’s lake and gardens.
Nuwara Eliya and Ella: ride the scenic train through tea country, hike to viewpoints, and see waterfalls.
Yala and Udawalawe: go on a safari to spot elephants, leopards, and birdlife.
Mirissa, Bentota, and the South Coast: relax on tropical beaches or go whale watching.

tailorMade.title: Tailor-Made Tour Packages
tailorMade.text: Whether you have one week or three, we build your route around your interests. Choose a classic cultural round trip, a wildlife-focused journey, a honeymoon with beach time, or a family holiday with flexible days. Our sample itineraries are a starting point. We adjust hotels, activities, and travel days until the plan fits you.
